newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Conrail a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Conrail a hold.

text.p: -- PaineWebber said it recommends holding Conrail Inc shares in anticipation of a higher bid for the company.
-- Conrail agreed to a friendly merger agreement with CSX Corp, under terms that were sweetened yesterday to $110 per share in cash for the first 40 percent of shares tendered.
-- For the remaining 60 percent, stock would be swapped at the rate of 1.85619 CSX shares for each Conrail share, terms that were unchanged from the original offer.
-- Meanwhile, Norfolk Southern Corp has submitted an unwelcome, $100 per share, all cash ofer, a bid widely speculated to be raised.
